lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Semi-regular vertical columns containing 3 to 5 high-luminance circular blobs. Columns are roughly parallel with consistent spacing moving posterior from the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the primary circular blobs, forming a visible grid-like pattern across the mid-flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges characterized by a light-to-dark vertical gradient (highlight on top, shadow below) running parallel to the long axis of the body.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin exhibits a high density of smaller, randomly distributed high-luminance spots compared to the structured grid of the lateral flank.
